s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.body: The data controller for your personal data is the Patrimonio account holder. The application is a personal financial management tool and does not share data with third parties without explicit consent.

s2.title: 2. Data we collect
s2.body: We only collect data you voluntarily enter:
s2.item2: Financial data: accounts, transactions, investments, and budgets you create.
s2.item3: Usage data: access logs and errors to improve the service (via Sentry).
s2.item4: Technical data: IP address and user agent for security and rate limiting.

s3.title: 3. Your rights (GDPR)
s3.body: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679, you have the right to:
s3.item1: Access: request a copy of all your data in JSON format from Settings > Privacy.
s3.item2: Rectification: modify your personal data from your profile.
s3.item3: Erasure: delete your account and all associated data from Settings > Account.
s3.item4: Portability: export your data as a ZIP/JSON file.
s3.item5: Objection: we do not use your data for advertising profiles.

s4.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
s4.body: Processing is based on the user's explicit consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) upon registration and acceptance of these terms, and on legitimate interests in security (Art. 6.1.f GDPR) for fraud detection and rate limiting.

s5.title: 5. Service providers (processors)
s5.body: Your data is stored on Supabase (PostgreSQL in Europe, eu-central-1 region). Hosting infrastructure is Vercel (global CDN). Error monitoring uses Sentry, configured to exclude financial data and email addresses from reports.

s6.title: 6. International transfers
s6.body: Supabase stores data in the European Union. Vercel and Sentry may process metadata (not financial data) on servers outside the EU under Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

s7.title: 7. Data retention
s7.body: Your data is retained while your account is active. Upon account deletion, all data is deleted in cascade within a maximum of 30 days.

s8.title: 8. Security
s8.body: All data is transmitted via TLS 1.3 and stored encrypted at rest (AES-256). Access is protected with JWT authentication, optional 2FA TOTP, and row-level security (RLS) policies in the database.

s9.title: 9. Contact
s9.body: To exercise your rights or resolve any privacy-related query, write to: privacy@patrimonio.app

s1.title: 1. Acceptance
s1.body: By registering and using Patrimonio, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you disagree, do not use the application.

s2.title: 2. Service description
s2.body: Patrimonio is a personal wealth management PWA. It allows you to track income, expenses, investments, and personal budgets. It is not a regulated financial advisory service.

s3.title: 3. Financial disclaimer
s3.body: IMPORTANT NOTICE: Patrimonio does not provide financial, tax, or investment advice. Information displayed (including market data, projections, and analysis) is for informational purposes only. Financial decisions are solely the user's responsibility. Consult a certified financial advisor before making investment decisions.

s4.title: 4. Acceptable use
s4.item1: Using the application for illegal or fraudulent activities.
s4.item2: Attempting to access other users' data.
s4.item3: Performing load tests or automated attacks against the service.

s5.title: 5. Availability
s5.body: Patrimonio is provided "as is". We do not guarantee 100% uptime. We may interrupt the service for maintenance with prior notice when possible.

s6.title: 6. Code ownership
s6.body: Patrimonio's source code is available under the MIT license. Data entered by the user is the exclusive property of the user.

s7.title: 7. Modifications
s7.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Significant changes will be notified by email at least 15 days in advance.

s8.title: 8. Governing law
s8.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, both parties submit to the courts and tribunals of Madrid.
